notes.title: Crafting BETA 2.0 & Drop Pool Changes
notes.notes:
I'm thrilled to announce the addition of [b]27 new Honey Tapples[/b] in Tapple Town! These tapples bring a fresh twist to the game and can be acquired through crafting or exchanging.

[b]🔹 Crafting & Exchange:[/b]
• [b]Exchange two Colored Honey Tapples[/b] to receive a [b]Gilded Honey Tapple[/b].
• Dive into our new [b]Crafting BETA 2.0[/b]! Use the seeds you’ve been saving to open Honey Chests and discover special rewards.
• The crafting system is not fully optimized yet but I know you gamers have been requesting it! I will continue to make updates to the UI & code to provide a better experience.

[b]🔹 Drop Pool Update:[/b]
• The drop pool now features only [b]two items[/b]: the [b]Base Tapple[/b] and the [b]GG Honey Tapple[/b] at a VERY LOW %.

[b]🔹 Developer Note:[/b]
• I plan to continue adding more features to Tapple - Idle Clicker to make it much more than just a "clicker" game, special thanks to everyone who is playing daily! I love seeing screenshots uploaded to the Steam Community/Discord and hope Tapple continues growing with your help!

notes.title: New Update: Canvas Legends Set & More!
notes.notes:
[h3]Game Update Notes[/h3]

[h2]New Additions and Changes:[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]New Drops:[/b] 20 new drops have been added.
[*][b]Removed Drops:[/b] The old drop pool has been removed.
[*][b]Item Name Colors:[/b] Item name colors now resemble the set they belong to.
[*][b]Rarity Adjustments:[/b]
[*][b]Newton's Tapple:[/b] Changed to Uncommon.
[*][b]Green Tapple:[/b] Changed to Uncommon.
[*][b]Basic Tapple:[/b] The only true Common drop currently. Future Common items will remain in the drop pool forever.
[/list]

[h2]Important Information:[/h2]

[list]
[*]The recent changes did not affect the drop rate, but going forward, Common items will be those that stay in the drop pool permanently.
[*]I am working on game updates day in and day out. If you experienced issues with the last update, it’s due to the change in code.
[/list]

[h2]Issue Resolution:[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]To avoid any issues with breaking the game, please follow these steps:[/b]
[*]Hold the backspace key.
[*]Reset the game to 0.
[*]Close Tapple.
[*]Relaunch Tapple.
[*]This method has been reported to work based on user feedback and has been tested during playtesting.
[/list]

[h2]Thanks for Playing! Seriously[/h2]

[list]
[*]I apologize for any confusion caused by the lack of prior information. Thank you for your understanding.
[*]Enjoy the new [b]Canvas Legends[/b] set!
[/list]
